records.runnable_test_name: test/tdd/001-zero-touch-native-distribution/a1_test.dart::A1::the Rust native library is linked into the app by the macOS adapter package's own Swift package (a `binaryTarget` over the shipped xcframework), and the consumer's project files contain no reference to the native library.

test/tdd/001-zero-touch-native-distribution/a2_test.dart::A2::the Rust native library is packaged into the app from the Android adapter package's own `jniLibs`, and the consumer's project files contain no reference to the native library.
test/tdd/001-zero-touch-native-distribution/a3_test.dart::A3::the Rust native library is linked into the app by the iOS adapter package's own Swift package, exactly as the macOS adapter does.
test/tdd/001-zero-touch-native-distribution/a4_test.dart::A4::the conversion goes through the shared `zuraffa_ffi_platform` envelope, and the adapter declares no envelope of its own.

test/tdd/001-zero-touch-native-distribution/a5_test.dart::A5::all six family packages resolve through one pub workspace on the latest zuraffa release, and every member carries the same release version.
